claude_policy: Exact separate upstream target at the same commit; no Codex transform applies.
certification: No actual desktop, native Cloud or provider qualification is implied by packaging or local tests.

resource_dispatch.qualification: Complete package activation and invocation-policy transport must be checked on the actual host.

deployment_profiles.qualification: A configuration name does not establish account entitlement, native capabilities or authority.

role_models.qualification: Use actual observed model catalogs and supported effort/speed mappings; preserve source-specific fallback.

native_original_history.implementation: runtime/history.py evidence validation and explicit unavailable outcomes
native_original_history.qualification: Requires genuine current and historical native records in scope before required handoff. Managed child traces and model-authored journals do not substitute.

durable_execution.qualification: External deployment, real provider access, lifecycle/stop, ownership and evidence export need independent acceptance. No service is provisioned by plugin generation.

independent_review.implementation: Observed provider/model identity and source-specific review rules
independent_review.qualification: Another originating vendor is mandatory only where the caller requires it. Shipping requires a non-author verifier; Arena's unavailable-judge outcome cannot satisfy show-me.

blind_trials.implementation: runtime/workers.py and the explicit Eval trial-role binding
blind_trials.qualification: Actual files, tools, history, credentials and treatment identity must be isolated. A prompt or no-history flag alone does not prove the boundary.

authoring_overrides.implementation: Effective body resolution outside immutable plugin caches
authoring_overrides.qualification: A description/discovery change additionally needs a supported host-visible replacement or precedence path.

watcher.qualification: Local fake-GitHub tests do not certify native host permissions or authorize merging. Linux uses a dedicated child subreaper; other POSIX hosts provide group cleanup and require separate descendant qualification.
